# Tomb of Lord Reto

Type: Dungeon | Internal ID: PlaceofMystery3 | Location: Ashlands | Inhabitants: Lord Reto

# Introduction

The Tomb of Lord Reto is a dungeons found in Ashlands, the entrance is situated at the third Mysterious Location.

## Description

The interior is a small cave with no light and a couple of indestructible pillars in the middle.
The only creature inside is the 2-star miniboss Lord Reto.

Categorias: Points of interest, Dungeons
